inline_comments: Detects context poisoning attacks in agent memory stores (OWASP ASI-06). Scans context entries for known attack patterns including prompt injection, context window stuffing, high-entropy payloads, and repetition flooding. Also validates memory isolation between agent sessions.
Add a context entry to the store and compute its integrity hash.
Scan all stored context entries for poisoning indicators.
Check repetition across entries in the same session
Scan a single context entry for poisoning patterns.
Verify integrity of all stored entries. Returns false if any entry has been tampered with.
Check memory isolation between sessions for the same agent.
Check for content leaking between sessions
Get all stored entries for a specific agent/session.
Clear all entries for a specific agent/session.

functions.name: addEntry
functions.doc: Add a context entry to the store and compute its integrity hash.

functions.name: scan
functions.doc: Scan all stored context entries for poisoning indicators.

functions.name: scanEntry
functions.doc: Scan a single context entry for poisoning patterns.

functions.name: verifyIntegrity
functions.doc: Verify integrity of all stored entries.     Returns false if any entry has been tampered with.

functions.name: checkIsolation
functions.doc: Check memory isolation between sessions for the same agent.

functions.name: getEntries
functions.doc: Get all stored entries for a specific agent.

functions.name: clearSession
functions.doc: Clear all entries for a specific agent.
